theorem if_pos {c : Prop} {h : Decidable c} (hc : c) {α : Sort u} {t e : α} : (ite c t e) = t :=
  match h with
  | isTrue  _   => rfl
  | isFalse hnc => absurd hc hnc

theorem if_neg {c : Prop} {h : Decidable c} (hnc : ¬c) {α : Sort u} {t e : α} : (ite c t e) = e :=
  match h with
  | isTrue hc   => absurd hc hnc
  | isFalse _   => rfl

logic: Supply the original full conjunction directly as hc/hnc to core if_pos/if_neg. Both conditionals, one over a continuous-linear-map and one over Real, then reduce to the same projection or zero. This avoids inserting hi as a raw proposition rewrite which recursively changes the full condition into True ∧ ¬False. No finite comparison, selected predicate or coordinate is changed.
